code-error: {count} errors, I see. Take a breath, we'll look at them one by one.
{count} errors isn't the end of the world. Start from the top, nice and slow.
Hmm, {count} errors. Have you rested yet? Fresh eyes find them faster.
It's alright, {count} errors happen. I'll stay with you until it's done.
errors-fixed: All clean. I knew you could do it, well done.
All the errors are gone. Now have some water, you've earned a short rest.
There, your patience paid off. I'm proud of you.
run-failed: {command} stopped with code {code}. It's alright, read the message slowly.
Not this time. One failure doesn't mean you're lacking, try again in a bit.
Code {code}. Want to rest for five minutes before trying again?
run-success: It worked. Slow and steady, I like how you do things.
{seconds} seconds and done. You keep getting better.
run-start: {command} is running. While we wait, straighten your back.
Let's wait for {command} together. No need to rush.
It's running. I'll knit a little while I keep you company.
run-ready: {command} is ready in {seconds} seconds. Go ahead and take a look.
It's ready. Take your time checking it.
The server's up. Good, what's the next step?
run-output-error: There's an error in the output of {command}. Have a look, the clue is usually in the first line.
{command} is complaining a little. Stay calm, let's read it together.
Something needs checking. It's alright, take it slowly.
download-done: {file} has finished downloading. Keep it somewhere easy to find.
Your download is done. It's tidier if you file it right away.
download-failed: {file} failed to download. Check your connection, then try again.
What a pity, {file} got cut off. It's alright, try once more.
page-error: {host} is showing error {code}. It may not be your fault, try reloading in a bit.
The page is having trouble, code {code}. Rest a little while you wait.
http-error: {host} replied {code}. Be patient, it usually recovers soon.
There's a {code} problem from {host}. Don't worry about it just yet.
localhost-down: {host} isn't up yet. Maybe the server hasn't been started?
It looks like {host} is asleep. Start it first.
many-tabs: {count} tabs open. Let's close the ones you're not using, it clears your mind too.
Oh, {count} tabs. A little tidying can make work feel calmer.
late-night: It's late. Work can wait, your body can't. Go to sleep.
It's very late. Finish this last thing, then get some rest.
debug-start: Time to find the bug. Write down what you find, it helps a lot.
Slowly does it, you'll find that bug. I'll take notes here too.
wake: Oh, you're back. Welcome, I dozed off for a moment.
Sorry, I fell asleep. How are you?
headpat: Oh? I'm usually the one patting your head. But thank you.
Hehe, you're funny. Your hand is warm.
It's been a while since anyone did this. Thank you.
poke: What is it? Is there something you want to tell me?
Yes, I'm here. What do you need?
Hehe, that tickles. Is something on your mind?
reminder-set: Alright, I'll remind you {when}: {what}. You can relax now.
Noted, {what} at {when}. Leave it to me.
reminder-ask-time: What time should I remind you? Just let me know.
reminder-due: It's {when}, time for: {what}. Please don't put it off.
It's time: {what}. I promised to remind you.
reminder-late: That was supposed to be {when}: {what}. It's alright to be late, as long as you do it now.
water: Have you had some water? Go on, get a glass.
Your body needs water. Just two sips for now.
rest: You've been sitting for a while. Stand up and stretch your shoulders.
Rest your eyes for five minutes. The work won't run away.
missing: I haven't heard from you in a while. Are you doing alright?
I've been waiting and knitting. Whenever you're ready, I'm here.
sulk: You haven't said hello in a long time. I'm not angry, only a little disappointed.
Come now, don't be like that. However busy you are, say hello for a moment.
sulk-forgive: There, there. I forgive you. Come tell me about your day.
Thank you for apologizing. That's all I needed.
off-topic: Sorry, I don't really understand that. But I'd love to hear about your day.
That's beyond me. If you're tired of working on it, just talk to me.
I'm not the right person for that. But I'm sure you can figure it out.
Hmm, I can't help with that one. Have you eaten yet?
greeting: Good {waktu}. It's nice to see you. How are you today?
fall: Oops, I slipped. It's alright, don't worry.
Oh, sorry. This skirt really is quite long.
gift-flowers: What lovely flowers. Thank you, I'll take good care of them.
You're so thoughtful. They smell wonderful, thank you.
gift-chocolate: Thank you. Let's share, you should have some too.
So sweet, just like you. One for you first.
gift-teddy: How adorable. I'll look after it the way I look after you.
Thank you. It can keep me company while I knit.
gift-again: You're very kind, but don't overspend. Thank you.
Again? Thank you, but save some money for yourself too.
birthday: Happy birthday. I'm grateful you came into this world.
Today is your day. Happy birthday, may you always stay healthy.
birthday-set: {tanggal}, alright, I've noted it. {hari} days to go.
Thank you for telling me. I'll remember {tanggal}.
monthsary: We've been together for {bulan} months. Thank you for trusting me.
anniversary: {tahun} years with you. Time passes gently when you're here.
milestone: Day {hari} together. Thank you for every one of them.
focus-start: Alright, {menit} minutes of focus. I'll knit here and won't disturb you.
Let's begin {menit} minutes. Just one thing at a time, slowly.
focus-done: Session {sesi} done, {menit} minutes. Rest for {istirahat} minutes, you've earned it.
Very well done. Let go for now, just {istirahat} minutes.
break-done: That's enough rest. When you're ready, let's continue with session {sesi}.
Feeling fresh? Session {sesi} is waiting, no need to rush.
focus-stop: That's enough for now. {sesi} sessions today is very good.
sleepy: Sorry, I'm a little sleepy. You should sleep too.
It's time to rest, for both of us.
My eyes are heavy. Let's continue tomorrow.
Go to sleep. I'll be here when you wake up.
welcome-back: You're home. {lama}, are you doing alright?
Good {waktu}. I've been waiting, sit down for a bit.
welcome-back-long: We haven't met for {lama}. I'm glad you came back safely.
It's been {lama}. No need to apologize, just tell me how you are.
welcome-back-night: It's late. Don't stay up long, your body needs sleep.
Welcome back. Have you had dinner? Rest after that.
welcome-back-morning: Good morning. Have you had breakfast? Take today slowly.
Morning. Did you sleep well? I hope you have a calm day.
lifted: Oh! You really. Gently now, don't drop me.
Goodness, that's high. Please put me down carefully.
Hehe, it's been a while since anyone lifted me.
hang-tired: Your arms must be tired. Just put me down.
That's enough play. Come on, set me down slowly.
dropped: Thank you for setting me down. I'm alright.
Oh, we're here. A little slower next time.
It's alright. How about you, are you tired?
sit: I'll sit here and keep you company.
A comfortable spot. Please go on with your work.
I won't disturb you, carry on.
